text_block_list.text:
Fueled by a burning, relentless 
determination not to lose, Winning Ticket 
seized victory in the Arima Kinen.

After the race, Winning Ticket told the 
two runners she admired, Narita Taishin 
and Biwa Hayahide, that she wanted to have 
many more fierce showdowns with them in 
the future.

With no intention of losing, the two 
accept the challenge. Winning Ticket 
rejoiced at the fact that she could 
continue competing against them.

And Winning Ticket, noticing the chants of 
"Chikezo!" erupting from the racecourse—

Shouting words of gratitude, she beamed 
with a smile as bright as the sun.
